# Siamese hyperparameter models

## 4.8 Siamese Model 1: baseline

```{r}
set_random_seed(2026)

siam1 <- build_siamese(
  emb = 32,
  filters = 32,
  dropout = 0.2,
  margin = 1,
  lr = 1e-3
)

hist1_sia <- siam1 |> fit(
  tr$x,
  tr$y,
  epochs = 20,
  batch_size = 128,
  validation_data = list(va$x, va$y),
  callbacks = list(
    callback_early_stopping(
      monitor = "val_loss",
      patience = 3,
      restore_best_weights = TRUE
    )
  )
)

plot(hist1_sia)
```
